🎬 Chasing Secrets (1999)

Also known as The Secret Path, Chasing Secrets tells the deeply moving story of a young girl named Jo Ann Foley who grows up in an abusive and neglectful household in the American South during the 1950s. Desperate to escape her painful circumstances, Jo Ann discovers an unexpected source of love and comfort in an elderly African American couple, Honey and Too Tall, who welcome her into their lives. Despite living in a society divided by racial prejudice and segregation, the couple provides Jo Ann with the kindness, protection, and emotional support she has never experienced from her own family. As their relationship grows stronger, Jo Ann begins to understand the true meaning of unconditional love and belonging. Starring Della Reese, Ossie Davis, and Madeline Zima, the film delivers an emotional and inspiring story about compassion, childhood trauma, racial inequality, resilience, and the powerful bonds that can exist beyond blood relationships.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Biography • Historical Drama

⭐ IMDb: 7.7/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 34m • Unrated

🎥 Director: Bruce Pittman

✍️ Writers: Bill C. Davis & Quinton Peeples

📚 Based On: Childhood’s Thief by Rose Mary Evans.

📍 Setting: Rural Tennessee during World War II in the 1940s.

📺 Where to Watch: Tubi, The Roku Channel, Amazon Prime Video, and Apple TV (United States).
